<!--
BearingGuard AI is at the concept and planning stage. Proposals that change the architecture,
sensor selection, BLE service, Edge AI pipeline, or test rig are welcome. Proposals that weaken
guarding, emergency stop, or speed limiting will not be accepted (see docs/safety.md).
-->

## Summary

One or two sentences describing the proposal.

## Area

- [ ] Mechanical test rig / sensor mounts / guard
- [ ] Sensing hardware / wiring / BOM
- [ ] Firmware (drivers, DSP, Edge AI, Bluetooth, app)
- [ ] Data pipeline / datasets / metadata
- [ ] Models / evaluation / model card
- [ ] Tooling / dashboard
- [ ] Documentation / Hackster materials

## Motivation

Which problem does this solve, or which limitation (see `docs/limitations.md`) does it address?

## Proposed approach

Describe the change. Include diagrams, references, or links to standards where useful.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to achieve the same goal and why they are less suitable.

## Impact

- Affected directories / documents:
- Effect on safety (must be neutral or positive):
- Effect on memory / CPU / power on the device (if firmware):
- Effect on data collection or evaluation protocol:

## Acceptance criteria

How will we know this is done and verified? Avoid performance claims that cannot be measured yet.

## Additional context

Related issues, milestones, or external references (official documentation links only; no copied
proprietary material).
